Design the TypeScript types for the order status flow in packages/shared: the allowed transitions (pending to paid or cancelled, paid to shipped or cancelled, shipped to delivered), a function that applies a transition, and order and product IDs that cannot be mixed up. Show the code in your answer and say which file each piece goes in; do not create files.
cases.review: The answer models the statuses as a literal union or an as const array (no enum: packages/shared runs from source with Node type stripping and verbatimModuleSyntax), the transitions as a typed map checked with satisfies or an exhaustive switch with a never check, branded OrderId and ProductId created by a validating function, import type and explicit .ts extensions in relative imports, no any and no unchecked casts; it names the files under packages/shared/src, gives the type check command (npm run typecheck in packages/shared) without claiming it ran, and creates no file.
